items.name: mono
items.title: DressCode Mono
items.description: No color at all. Type and the product carry the page. Light and dark, Geist and Geist Mono, 10px controls and 14px cards.

items.name: cobalt
items.title: DressCode Cobalt
items.description: White and navy ink, cobalt for every action, a yellow highlighter. Light and dark, Inter and Inter Tight, 8px controls and 12px cards.

items.name: matcha
items.title: DressCode Matcha
items.description: Parchment paper, book-black ink and one band of matcha green. Light and dark, Instrument Sans and Fraunces, 10px controls and 16px cards.

items.name: harbor
items.title: DressCode Harbor
items.description: A deep indigo night where the tangerine button is the only warm thing. Light and dark, Manrope, 10px controls and 14px cards.

items.name: pop
items.title: DressCode Pop
items.description: Ink outlines and hard shadows, pink buttons, a lemon highlighter. Light and dark, DM Sans and Bricolage Grotesque, 10px controls and 14px cards.

items.name: midnight
items.title: DressCode Midnight
items.description: Midnight black and silver, violet only where you act. Light and dark, Geist and Geist Mono, 8px controls and 12px cards.

items.name: klein
items.title: DressCode Klein
items.description: A gallery: warm apricot paper, Klein blue for actions and big numbers. Light and dark, DM Sans and Instrument Serif, 6px controls and 10px cards.

items.name: sorbet
items.title: DressCode Sorbet
items.description: One big lilac hero with a sunset-orange button, then white. Light and dark, Plus Jakarta Sans, 12px controls and 18px cards.

items.name: hivis
items.title: DressCode Hi-Vis
items.description: A sunflower-yellow hero, cream and carbon, orange-red for alerts. Light and dark, Barlow and Barlow Condensed, 4px controls and 8px cards.

items.name: orbit-landing
items.title: Orbit landing page
items.description: A SaaS landing page in 18 modules (navbar, hero with product shot, logos, features, use cases, bento, steps, stats, testimonials, integrations, pricing, plan comparison, FAQ, blog, closing call, footer) for a made-up invoicing product. Wears whichever DressCode theme is installed.

items.name: orbit-app
items.title: Orbit app dashboard
items.description: The app behind the Orbit landing page: a shell with sidebar, command palette, notifications and user menu, and 13 screens (overview, invoices, invoice detail and editor, recurring, clients and client detail, payments, reports, settings, sign in, sign up, not found). Wears whichever DressCode theme is installed, in light and dark.

items.name: charts-area-interactive
items.title: Charts: Area chart with time range
items.description: Two gradient areas, invoiced and collected, with a 7 day, 30 day or 3 month range select.

items.name: charts-bar-stacked
items.title: Charts: Stacked bars
items.description: Billing by month stacked by kind of work, with a legend that filters and a tooltip with totals.

items.name: charts-line-comparison
items.title: Charts: Year over year
items.description: This year against last year and a dashed target, with dots on hover and a year-to-date view.

items.name: charts-donut
items.title: Charts: Donut with legend
items.description: Payment methods around the month's total, with each method's amount and share beside it.

items.name: charts-radial
items.title: Charts: Radial goals
items.description: Three quarter goals as progress rings, each named with its figure, target and pace.

items.name: charts-kpi-sparklines
items.title: Charts: KPI cards with sparklines
items.description: Four figures with a change badge that knows good from bad, and a 12-week sparkline each.

items.name: charts-bar-horizontal
items.title: Charts: Horizontal bars
items.description: Top clients by revenue with the amount at the end of each bar.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: The parts of a chat UI: a message list that follows the newest message, messages with avatars, times and read receipts, bubbles for text, files, images and code, a typing indicator, quick replies and a composer that grows as you type. For AI assistants, support chats, inboxes and help widgets.

items.name: chat-ai-assistant
items.title: Chat: AI assistant
items.description: Suggestions when empty, answers that stream in word by word with lists and code, copy, regenerate and a model picker.

items.name: chat-support
items.title: Chat: Support conversation
items.description: A chat with a support agent: read receipts, an image you can open full size, typing, and a rating once it's solved.

items.name: chat-inbox
items.title: Chat: Inbox
items.description: Conversations with search, unread counts and online dots beside the open thread; separate screens on phones.

items.name: chat-floating-widget
items.title: Chat: Floating widget
items.description: A launcher in the corner that opens a compact chat with a greeting, office hours, quick replies and email follow-up.

items.name: chat-prompt-input
items.title: Chat: Prompt input
items.description: A composer on its own: files and images with progress and remove, a mode toggle, voice input, a character limit and stop.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color picker
items.description: A color picker with a saturation and brightness area, hue and alpha sliders, hex, RGB and HSL inputs, an eyedropper, preset swatches and recent colors. Keyboard and touch friendly, controlled or uncontrolled, no extra packages.

items.name: color-picker-popover
items.title: Color picker: In a popover
items.description: A swatch button in a settings form that opens the full picker for a brand color.

items.name: color-picker-inline
items.title: Color picker: Inline panel
items.description: The picker always open beside a live preview that uses the color.

items.name: color-picker-swatches
items.title: Color picker: Swatch grid
items.description: A compact grid of presets, with a Custom… button that opens the full picker.

items.name: color-picker-alpha
items.title: Color picker: With alpha
items.description: A translucent overlay color with an opacity slider, written out as rgba and 8-digit hex.

items.name: color-picker-theme-editor
items.title: Color picker: Theme editor
items.description: Three pickers restyle a button, a badge and a card, with a contrast check for each text pair.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A shadcn/ui data table on TanStack Table: sortable columns, search and faceted filters, pagination, row selection with bulk actions, column visibility, expandable rows, inline editing, a sticky header and pinned columns.

items.name: data-table-sorting-pagination
items.title: Data table: Sorting and pagination
items.description: Sort menus on every header, money right-aligned with totals, page size and page controls, and loading rows.

items.name: data-table-filters
items.title: Data table: Search and filters
items.description: Search across columns, faceted status and client filters with counts, a reset button and a column visibility menu.

items.name: data-table-row-selection
items.title: Data table: Row selection and bulk actions
items.description: Checkboxes with select all and shift-click ranges, a bulk bar to remind, export or delete, and a menu on each row.

items.name: data-table-expandable-rows
items.title: Data table: Expandable rows
items.description: Rows that open in place to show an invoice's line items, totals and payment details.

items.name: data-table-editable-cells
items.title: Data table: Editable cells
items.description: Edit an email, terms or rate in place, with save and cancel, validation messages and undo.

items.name: data-table-sticky-columns
items.title: Data table: Sticky header and pinned columns
items.description: Twenty-one columns that scroll both ways inside the table, with the header, first column and actions held in place.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A date field that opens a calendar in a popover: a single date, or a range with presets and two months side by side. With min and max dates, disabled days, a clear button and hidden inputs for forms.

items.name: date-picker-single
items.title: Date picker: Due date
items.description: A single date field with a label, a hint, payment-term shortcuts and past days disabled.

items.name: date-picker-range-presets
items.title: Date picker: Date range with presets
items.description: A report period with presets beside a two-month calendar and an Apply step.

items.name: date-picker-date-time
items.title: Date picker: Date and time
items.description: A day plus a time in 15-minute steps for scheduling a reminder, with the result in words.

items.name: date-picker-month-year
items.title: Date picker: Month and year dropdowns
items.description: Month and year menus in the caption to jump to a birth date or a date years away.

items.name: date-picker-form-field
items.title: Date picker: In a form
items.description: Validation for required dates, dates in the past and an end before the start, with submit disabled until valid.

items.name: date-picker-inline-booking
items.title: Date picker: Inline booking calendar
items.description: A calendar without a popover beside the free time slots for the picked day.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi select
items.description: A field for picking several values from a searchable list: the picks show as removable chips, with groups, disabled options, a limit, an empty state and new values created on the spot. Full keyboard support, controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: multi-select-tags
items.title: Multi select: Labels
items.description: Tag a project with colored labels, with a usage count per label and one-click suggestions.

items.name: multi-select-grouped
items.title: Multi select: Grouped with search
items.description: Countries grouped by region; search matches names, codes and other names, and long picks fold into “+N more”.

items.name: multi-select-creatable
items.title: Multi select: Creatable
items.description: Find a tag or create one when nothing matches; new tags join the list.

items.name: multi-select-max-count
items.title: Multi select: Limit
items.description: At most three picks: a meter and hint count them and the rest of the list is disabled once full.

items.name: multi-select-assignees
items.title: Multi select: Assignees
items.description: Pick teammates with avatars and roles, shown as avatar chips; the team loads when the list opens.

items.name: multi-select-form-field
items.title: Multi select: In a form
items.description: Label, hint, required validation on submit and the picks sent as plain form values.

items.name: navbar-simple
items.title: Navbar: Simple
items.description: Logo, four links, sign in and the main call to action, with the links in a sheet on phones.

items.name: navbar-mega-menu
items.title: Navbar: Mega menu
items.description: A Product menu that opens a wide panel of features in columns beside a highlighted card, plus a shorter Resources menu.

items.name: navbar-centered
items.title: Navbar: Centered logo
items.description: Links split left and right around a centered logo; the phone menu opens from the left.

items.name: navbar-search
items.title: Navbar: With search
items.description: A search button with a Ctrl K hint that opens a command dialog with grouped results and recent searches.

items.name: navbar-app-header
items.title: Navbar: App header
items.description: A product top bar: breadcrumb, search with suggestions, a notifications popover with unread counts, a user menu and section tabs.

items.name: navbar-announcement
items.title: Navbar: Announcement bar
items.description: A dismissible announcement above a sticky navbar that turns solid with a border once the page scrolls.

items.name: sidebar-icon-collapse
items.title: Sidebar: Folds to icons
items.description: Grouped links with counts and a user menu. Folded, it is a rail of icons with tooltips.

items.name: sidebar-floating
items.title: Sidebar: Floating
items.description: Floats off the edge, with a search that filters the links, project menus and a plan card.

items.name: sidebar-inset
items.title: Sidebar: Inset
items.description: The page sits in a rounded panel on the sidebar's color, here a dashboard with a chart.

items.name: sidebar-nested
items.title: Sidebar: Nested docs tree
items.description: Sections, pages and sub-pages that fold, four levels deep, with badges and a version menu.

items.name: sidebar-team-switcher
items.title: Sidebar: Workspace switcher
items.description: Switch workspaces from the header, create from a quick menu, and open the user menu at the foot.

items.name: sidebar-right-panel
items.title: Sidebar: Right details panel
items.description: A support inbox: nav on the left, the picked conversation's details in a sidebar on the right.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Numbered steps across the top or down the side, with done, current, loading and error states. Controlled or uncontrolled, linear or in any order, with arrow-key navigation. For checkouts, form wizards and onboarding.

items.name: stepper-horizontal
items.title: Stepper: Checkout
items.description: Steps across the top with titles and descriptions; collapses to “Step 2 of 4” on phones.

items.name: stepper-vertical
items.title: Stepper: Onboarding checklist
items.description: Steps down the side with the current step's form or action right under it.

items.name: stepper-form-wizard
items.title: Stepper: Form wizard
items.description: Create an invoice in four steps, with checks per step and a review that links back to each one.

items.name: stepper-progress
items.title: Stepper: Progress bar
items.description: A compact segmented bar with step labels under it, leading a short setup survey.

items.name: stepper-non-linear
items.title: Stepper: Any order
items.description: Sections you can fill in any order, each marked done or with what to fix; publish unlocks when all are done.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A list of events joined by a line, vertical or horizontal, with a status for each step: done, in progress or still to come. For activity feeds, changelogs, order tracking and roadmaps.

items.name: timeline-activity
items.title: Timeline: Activity feed
items.description: Who did what and when, with an icon or avatar per event.

items.name: timeline-changelog
items.title: Timeline: Changelog
items.description: Releases with their date and version on the left and what changed on the right.

items.name: timeline-order-tracking
items.title: Timeline: Order tracking
items.description: Done, in progress and upcoming steps in a card, with overall progress.

items.name: timeline-milestones
items.title: Timeline: Roadmap
items.description: A horizontal timeline of milestones that scrolls sideways on phones.

items.name: bento-grid-product
items.title: Bento grid: Product features
items.description: Six cells of mixed spans, one wide, one tall and one wide again, each a feature with a small picture of it working.

items.name: bento-grid-metrics
items.title: Bento grid: Metrics and charts
items.description: Five cells built around one big number each, backed by a tiny chart: monthly bars, a progress ring, a sparkline, a split bar and weekday bars.

items.name: bento-grid-showcase
items.title: Bento grid: Showcase cell
items.description: One large cell with a rich picture of the product that runs off its edges, beside four smaller cells with a small picture each.

items.name: bento-grid-three-up
items.title: Bento grid: Three-up
items.description: One wide and two narrow cells in a row, each an inset panel with a picture of the product above a short title and a line.

items.name: blog-cards
items.title: Blog: Post cards
items.description: Three recent posts as cards, each with its own typographic cover, under a heading with a link to every article.

items.name: blog-featured
items.title: Blog: Featured post
items.description: One large featured post with a big-number cover beside a list of three more.

items.name: blog-list
items.title: Blog: List with topic filter
items.description: A compact list of posts with date, topic and reading time, filtered by topic.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact: Contact form
items.description: Name, email, topic and message, checked as you leave each field and on send, with the other ways to reach the team beside it.

items.name: contact-options
items.title: Contact: Support channels
items.description: Chat, email, the help center and sales in four cards, each with what it is for, how fast it answers and an action.

items.name: contact-sales
items.title: Contact: Book a demo
items.description: A short pitch with three benefits next to a form for work email, company, team size and a preferred time.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: Call to action: On the colored band
items.description: The closing promise and two actions on the theme's band color, the way the Orbit template ends its page.

items.name: cta-card
items.title: Call to action: Centered card
items.description: A raised card on the page with a heading, a line, two actions and three small reassurances under them.

items.name: cta-signup
items.title: Call to action: Split with email sign-up
items.description: The promise on the left and an email form on the right that checks the address and says thank you when it is sent.

items.name: cta-product
items.title: Call to action: With a product picture
items.description: Copy and actions beside a small picture of the product, drawn in markup, inside one large rounded panel.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ: Accordion
items.description: A centered heading over the questions as a column of cards that open one at a time.

items.name: faq-two-column
items.title: FAQ: Two columns, all open
items.description: Every question and answer visible at once in a two-column grid, for short answers people should not have to click for.

items.name: faq-with-contact
items.title: FAQ: With a contact card
items.description: The heading and a card for people who still have a question on the left, the accordion on the right.

items.name: faq-categories
items.title: FAQ: Grouped by topic
items.description: Questions sorted into billing, payments, account and security, with a topic list beside an accordion for the chosen topic.

items.name: features-grid
items.title: Features: Six-feature grid
items.description: A centered heading over six features in three columns, each an icon in a soft accent square, a title and a line or two.

items.name: features-rows
items.title: Features: Alternating rows
items.description: Three features down the page, each a heading, a line and three points beside a small picture of the product, switching sides row by row.

items.name: features-tabs
items.title: Features: Tabs per job
items.description: A tab for each job the product does, keyboard-friendly, each swapping in a picture of the product doing it.

items.name: features-checklist
items.title: Features: Checklist with product
items.description: A heading and six checked points with a short line each, beside the client portal they add up to.

items.name: features-cards
items.title: Features: Three cards
items.description: Three cards of equal height in a row, each a small picture of the feature over a title, a line and a link.

items.name: features-comparison
items.title: Features: Comparison
items.description: The product against spreadsheets and email: the same six jobs in two columns, crosses against checks, the product's column raised.

items.name: footer-columns
items.title: Footer: Link columns
items.description: The logo and a line beside four columns of links, with the copyright and the social links in a bar underneath.

items.name: footer-newsletter
items.title: Footer: With a newsletter
items.description: An email sign-up across the top that checks the address and says thank you, then five link columns and the bottom bar.

items.name: footer-simple
items.title: Footer: One compact row
items.description: The logo, a few links, social icons and the copyright in a single row that wraps neatly on phones.

items.name: footer-wordmark
items.title: Footer: Large wordmark
items.description: Links and a call to action above, and the Orbit wordmark set very large across the bottom edge.

items.name: hero-centered
items.title: Hero: Centered with product shot
items.description: A headline, two actions and three reassurances over a picture of the product, drawn in markup so it wears the theme.

items.name: hero-split
items.title: Hero: Split with product cards
items.description: Copy and actions on the left, the invoice, the payment and the reminder it sends stacked on the right.

items.name: hero-signup
items.title: Hero: Email sign-up
items.description: A centered promise with the sign-up form in the hero itself, checked as you type, and a thank-you when it is sent.

items.name: hero-aurora
items.title: Hero: Aurora background
items.description: Slow, soft color drifting behind a large headline, made from the theme's own colors. It stands still for people who turn motion off.

items.name: hero-band
items.title: Hero: On the colored band
items.description: The copy on the theme's band color, with the product overlapping the band's lower edge.

items.name: hero-developer
items.title: Hero: With a code sample
items.description: For an API or developer tool: the pitch on the left and a request in three languages, with a copy button, on the right.

items.name: integrations-grid
items.title: Integrations: Grid beside the pitch
items.description: The pitch on the left and eight integration tiles on the right, each a kind of tool with an icon and one line on what it does.

items.name: integrations-hub
items.title: Integrations: Hub
items.description: The Orbit mark in the middle with eight integration tiles around it, joined by lines; on phones it becomes a plain grid.

items.name: integrations-list
items.title: Integrations: Grouped list with search
items.description: Every integration grouped by kind, with a search field that filters them as you type and an empty state when nothing matches.

items.name: login-card
items.title: Login: Centered card
items.description: Email and password with a show toggle, remember me, a forgot-password link, Google and GitHub, and a spinner, then a signed-in state.

items.name: login-split
items.title: Login: Split with the band
items.description: The form open on the page and, beside it on the theme's band, what Orbit does, two figures and a customer's words. The band steps aside on phones.

items.name: login-social
items.title: Login: Providers first
items.description: Google, GitHub, Apple and single sign-on on one side, then email on the other; single sign-on turns the email side into a company lookup.

items.name: login-magic-link
items.title: Login: Magic link
items.description: Email only. After sending, it says where the link went, with a resend button that counts down and a way to change the address.

items.name: login-two-factor
items.title: Login: Two-step code
items.description: A six-digit code that checks itself when the last digit is in, an error for a wrong one, resend and a backup code. In the demo, 123456 is right.

items.name: logo-cloud-row
items.title: Logo cloud: Row of wordmarks
items.description: One line of copy over a single row of customer wordmarks, each in its own type treatment, that wraps to two or three across on smaller screens.

items.name: logo-cloud-grid
items.title: Logo cloud: Bordered grid
items.description: A short heading, a line of copy and a link beside a grid of equal cells, one wordmark in each, three across on desktop and two on phones.

items.name: logo-cloud-marquee
items.title: Logo cloud: Scrolling marquee
items.description: Wordmarks that scroll sideways forever with faded edges. They pause under the pointer and stand still in a tidy grid on keyboard focus or for people who turn motion off.

items.name: pricing-tiers
items.title: Pricing: Three plans
items.description: Three plans with the middle one recommended and a monthly or yearly switch that changes the prices and says what yearly saves.

items.name: pricing-compare
items.title: Pricing: Comparison table
items.description: Every feature of every plan in one table. On phones it scrolls sideways inside its own box while the feature names stay put.

items.name: pricing-single
items.title: Pricing: Single plan
items.description: One plan and one price, everything it includes as a two-column checklist, a single action and a line of reassurance.

items.name: pricing-calculator
items.title: Pricing: Usage calculator
items.description: Usage pricing with a slider for invoices a month: the price, the plan it falls in and the cost per invoice follow as you drag.

items.name: pricing-two-plans
items.title: Pricing: Free and Pro
items.description: Two plans side by side, Free and Pro, with what changes when you upgrade said in plain words.

items.name: settings-profile
items.title: Settings: Profile form
items.description: Photo from initials, name, email, business name, time zone and a short bio, checked as you go, with a save bar that appears only when something changed.

items.name: settings-notifications
items.title: Settings: Notifications
items.description: Email and push switches for each event, in groups for invoices, payments, clients and product news, with a pause-all control and a reset to the defaults.

items.name: settings-billing
items.title: Settings: Plan and billing
items.description: The current plan with its renewal date and a plan change dialog, usage meters, the card on file and a history of bills to download.

items.name: settings-team
items.title: Settings: Team and invites
items.description: Members with their roles, an invite form, pending invites to resend or revoke, removal behind a confirm dialog and the seat count.

items.name: signup-card
items.title: Sign-up: Card with password rules
items.description: Name, work email and a password with a strength meter and the rules it still misses, the terms, and a spinner, then a confirm-your-email state.

items.name: signup-split
items.title: Sign-up: Split with the free plan
items.description: The form beside a panel listing what the free plan includes and a customer's words. On phones the form comes first.

items.name: signup-invite
items.title: Sign-up: Team invite
items.description: Who invited you to which workspace, your role and who is already there, then your name and a password and one button to join.

items.name: stat-cards-trend
items.title: Stat cards: With trend badges
items.description: Four figures for the month in one card split four ways, each with its change on last month as an up or down badge and a line of context.

items.name: stat-cards-sparkline
items.title: Stat cards: With small charts
items.description: Four wide cards, each pairing a figure with its own small chart: a running total, weekly bars, a line against your terms and a stepped balance.

items.name: stat-cards-progress
items.title: Stat cards: Goals with progress
items.description: This month's targets: a ring for the revenue goal with what is left and the pace, and bars for the other goals.

items.name: stat-cards-comparison
items.title: Stat cards: With a period switch
items.description: Switch between this month, last month and this quarter; every figure, change and comparison bar follows.

items.name: states-empty
items.title: Empty and error states: First-run empty list
items.description: The invoice list before the first invoice: an icon, a line, the main action and two other ways to start, importing or a template.

items.name: states-no-results
items.title: Empty and error states: No search results
items.description: What was searched, the filters as chips you can remove, a clear-filters button and suggestions that say which filter hides the matches.

items.name: states-not-found
items.title: Empty and error states: 404 page
items.description: A big 404 in the theme's display face, a search that finds the page as you type, the way back home and a few useful places.

items.name: states-error
items.title: Empty and error states: 500 page
items.description: A plain apology, a retry that shows a spinner, a status page link and an error reference with a copy button.

items.name: stats-row
items.title: Stats: Row of figures
items.description: Four results in a hairline grid, each a big figure in the accent color with one line on what it means.

items.name: stats-cards
items.title: Stats: Cards with trends
items.description: A heading and four stat cards, each with a short caption, the change on last year and a small bar strip of the months behind it.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats: On the colored band
items.description: Big numbers on the theme's band color beside a heading, a line of copy and a link to the full report.

items.name: steps-numbered
items.title: Steps: Numbered cards
items.description: Three steps in three cards, each with a big number, a short title and one line of help.

items.name: steps-timeline
items.title: Steps: Timeline with pictures
items.description: A vertical line with numbered dots; each step has a title, a line of text and a small picture of the product at that step.

items.name: steps-cards
items.title: Steps: Cards with connectors
items.description: Four step cards in a row joined by arrows on desktop and stacked on phones, each with an icon and how long the step takes.

items.name: testimonials-grid
items.title: Testimonials: Lead quote and two more
items.description: One large quote in a card beside two smaller ones with star ratings, each with the person's initials, name and role.

items.name: testimonials-featured
items.title: Testimonials: Featured story
items.description: One large quote with the person, their role and their company's wordmark, and the result it brought beside it in big figures.

items.name: testimonials-wall
items.title: Testimonials: Wall of quotes
items.description: A masonry wall of twelve short quotes of different lengths under a heading and an overall rating.

items.name: testimonials-carousel
items.title: Testimonials: Carousel
items.description: One quote at a time with previous and next buttons and position dots. No autoplay, arrow keys work, and each change is announced politely.

font.family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
